methods_authorized.quote: includes but is not limited to: (1) initiating and maintaining comfort measures; (2) promoting and supporting optimal human functions and responses; (3) establishing an environment conducive to well-being or to the support of a dignified death; (4) collaborating on the health care regimen; (5) administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them; (6) recording and reporting nursing observations, assessments, interventions and responses to health care; (7) providing counseling and health teaching; (8) delegating and supervising nursing interventions that may be performed safely by others and are not in conflict with the Nursing Practice Act; and (9) maintaining accountability for safe and effective nursing care
